photos.c: The officials, pictured left, were (from the top left to right): Gordon Biscoe (timekeeper), John Sullivan (North London timekeeper), Don Anderson (timekeeper), Yak Stegner (Herne Hill timekeeper), Terry Earle (timekeeper), Pat Mead (track referee), Stuart Bennett (track judge), Bob Bridges (timekeeper), Richard Biscoe (track judge), Alan Mead (chief timekeeper), Leslie Earle (track judge). Not pictured but recording entries and assisting with the seeding was John Jeffery while starter was Bob Bush (Serpentine).
